title: Longitudinal sex representation in US dental schools from 2011 through 2025
html: The dental care profession continues to evolve alongside broader societal efforts to enhance diversity and representation in health care. The authors examined sex distributions among applicants, first-year students, and graduates in US predoctoral dental programs from 2011-2012 through 2024-2025, relative to the US adult population composition, and compared the sex distributions of public and private programs.
